verdict.rationale: doola's annual-report filing API lets a partner read what a state asks and charges before putting the report on file. Fee and state lookups are exposed as reference data, and the site lists headline pricing of $297/year plus state fees. However, no evidence gives an explicit list of which filings and states the annual-report service covers, or doola's own per-filing service fee. missing for 10: published list of supported annual-report states and filing types, doola's service fee for annual-report filings stated up front, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the filing service states which filings and states it covers and what it costs before I buy it

citations.quote: Read what a state asks and charges, put a company's annual report on file, confirm it, and follow it to completion.
Country, state, NAICS, and fee lookups live in the API reference so your forms always submit valid values.
A company's compliance calendar lists the recurring obligations doola tracks to keep it in good standing.
